scope: Exact stock player county populist exposure source; readonly disk reverse engineering only

title_joined_factions.semantics: Joined IDs come from the county component, without an ancestor-target filter. This is the stock title_joined_faction list source, not an inverse inference from targeting factions.
title_joined_factions.capacity_evidence: Data +0x3B0 and count +0x3BC directly read by stock builder; capacity +0x3B8 follows the same proven Pdx vector layout and is not consumed by this builder.

subrealm_titles.county_landless_semantics: For template tier 2, native predicate returns title+0x11C == 0; non-landless county has at least one title child at title+0x110/count+0x11C.
subrealm_titles.semantics: The stock walker enumerates held land-bearing titles and recursively follows generation-checked direct vassal-contract owners; exposure filters county tier afterward.
subrealm_titles.unsupported_claim: No proof is asserted that a joined faction target must be an ancestor of the county holder.

implementation_guidance: Read actual county joined FactionID spans. Resolve each full ID through the current Faction component store and use existing final power/threshold readers.
Use the native subrealm held-title/vassal-contract recursion, or a separately documented equivalent county membership source; do not limit faction targets to the actor ancestor chain.
Multiple joined factions for one county are legal rows; deduplicate exact county/faction pairs only.
Known empty county joined vectors are available empty; failed reads are unavailable, not zero exposure.
Do not traverse general faith/culture doctrine systems; the stock faction type remains an opaque key.
